summary: Revolution Medicines filed an 8-K solely to announce FDA approval of RASONQUE (daraxonrasib) for metastatic pancreatic adenocarcinoma, based on Phase 3 data. This is a regulatory product approval, not a corporate special situation. No M&A, tender, restructuring, or capital event occurred. The filing includes pricing details (wholesale acquisition cost) but no deal terms. Routine operational milestone, not triggering any special-situations classification.
